channel.title: The Grant Desk - NL, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: NL, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily.

item.title: 5 new grants - week of 24 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Human Rights Watch: AI Strategy and Solutions Lead (one-year fixed term)
    https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/humanrightswatch/jobs/8350654002
    Human Rights Watch (HRW), Operations Department · deadline Closed 30 Aug 2026 · USD 102,000 to 112,000 plus employer-paid benefits if based in the US; ranges outside the US are set by local market conditions. No application fee.
  • Fonds BJP: Dossiersubsidie for Freelance Regional and Local Journalists (autumn 2026 round)
    https://www.fondsbjp.nl/subsidies/
    Fonds Bijzondere Journalistieke Projecten (Fonds BJP) · deadline 14 Sep 2026 · Up to EUR 19,200 for six months of work on a single reporting dossier. No application fee.
  • Trust me, I'm an AI/rtist: Open Call for Creative Interventions
    https://waag.org/en/article/open-call-creative-interventions-trust-me-im-airtist/
    Waag Futurelab (Horizon Europe project HAMLET) · deadline 30 Sep 2026 · EUR 20,000 commission fee excluding VAT, inclusive of artist fee, travel, accommodation and production costs. Applicants must have a VAT number in Europe. No application fee.
  • Stimuleringsfonds: Open Call Residency Videotage 2027 (Hong Kong)
    https://www.stimuleringsfonds.nl/en/grants/open-call-videotage
    Stimuleringsfonds Creatieve Industrie (Creative Industries Fund NL) in collaboration with Videotage, Hong Kong · deadline 21 Oct 2026 · EUR 5,000 for a two-month residency or EUR 6,500 for a three-month residency, paid by the Creative Industries Fund NL to cover travel, insurance, living expenses, compensation for time invested, and material and transport costs. Accommodation, use of the studio space and facilitation by Videotage are covered directly by the Fund on top of this. No application fee.
  • Amsterdams Fonds voor de Kunst: Project Subsidies 2026-2028 (rolling)
    https://www.amsterdamsfondsvoordekunst.nl/aanvragen/
    Amsterdams Fonds voor de Kunst (AFK) · deadline Rolling / undated · Project grants across four categories, from small awards up to substantial project budgets. Requests up to EUR 7,500 in categories 1 and 2 are scheduled by monthly draw (loting) rather than a queue. No application fee.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 14 new grants - week of 17 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Mondriaan Fund: Inside-Out Art Museum Residency 2027 (Beijing)
    https://www.mondriaanfonds.nl/subsidie-aanvragen/regelingen/residency/inside-out-art-museum-beijing-china/
    Mondriaan Fund / Inside-Out Art Museum · deadline Closed 27 Aug 2026 · Subsidy of EUR 8,478 for an artist or EUR 5,622 for a curator/critic toward travel, material and living costs (a 10 percent personal contribution is automatically deducted by the Mondriaan Fund); studio, living space and Inside-Out Art Museum support are paid directly by the Mondriaan Fund. For a selected duo the total is increased proportionally to cover the second applicant's travel and accommodation. Contribution for Caribbean-based residents can be increased for higher travel costs. No application fee.
  • Gemeente Rotterdam: Project Subsidy Culture (Projectsubsidie Cultuur, September 2026 round)
    https://www.rotterdam.nl/projectsubsidie-cultuur-aanvragen
    Gemeente Rotterdam (Municipality of Rotterdam) · deadline Closed 01 Sep 2026 · No stated per-application cap. Annual pot EUR 1,632,000 split into six rounds of EUR 272,000, with roughly 130 applications per round. Discipline sub-caps: book writing max EUR 4,500; moving image R&D max EUR 4,000; moving-image production max EUR 12,500; post-production max EUR 4,000. Applicants must demonstrably seek other funds or sponsors. Awards over EUR 50,000 require an auditor's statement at reporting, at the applicant's cost. No application fee.
  • Kunstraad Groningen: Two-Year Programme Scheme (Tweejarige Programmaregeling, 2027-2028)
    https://kunstraadgroningen.nl/subsidies/tweejarige-programmaregeling/
    Kunstraad Groningen, on behalf of the municipality and province of Groningen · deadline Closed 01 Sep 2026 · EUR 5,000 minimum to EUR 40,000 maximum per year across two years, so up to EUR 80,000 total. Covers a maximum of one third of total project costs, requiring roughly 67 percent co-financing. Annual scheme budget EUR 325,000. No application fee.
  • JUGAAD: Absolute Improvisation, open call for printed matter and small-format works (Amsterdam)
    https://sacartamsterdam.com/upcoming-programmes/
    SAC Art Amsterdam and Mama Magnet · deadline 05 Sep 2026 · No application fee. Selected work is sold at the printed matter fair on mutually agreeable terms regarding commission, duration and number of editions; artists are remunerated within 30 days of each sale. Unsold works are returned at the end of the agreed consignment period.
  • Utrecht University: PhD, Media and Democracy in the 1970s (NWO Vidi project)
    https://www.academictransfer.com/en/jobs/362200/phd-media-and-democracy-in-the-1970s/
    Utrecht University, Faculty of Humanities, Department of History and Art History · deadline 06 Sep 2026 · EUR 3,059 to 3,881 gross per month at 36 to 40 hours per week, on the Dutch university PhD scale, plus 8 percent holiday allowance and 8.3 percent year-end bonus. No application fee.
  • Fonds Podiumkunsten: Foreign Performances or Concerts in the Netherlands (round 4, 2026)
    https://fondspodiumkunsten.nl/subsidies/buitenlandse-voorstellingen-of-concerten-in-nederland
    Fonds Podiumkunsten (Performing Arts Fund NL) · deadline 23 Sep 2026 · Maximum EUR 25,000 per production, capped at EUR 75,000 for an applicant presenting multiple productions. Calculated on travel and transport costs of the foreign artists and their production only. EUR 267,500 available per round shared across this scheme and two sibling internationalisation schemes. Fees, venue and production costs stay with the applicant. No application fee.
  • Gemeente Utrecht: Project Subsidy Culture (Projectsubsidie Cultuur, round 3 2026)
    https://loket.digitaal.utrecht.nl/nl/producten/projectsubsidie-cultuur-aanvragen
    Gemeente Utrecht (Municipality of Utrecht) · deadline 25 Sep 2026 · Category A: EUR 1,000 to 5,000. Category B: EUR 5,000 to 20,000. No fixed co-financing percentage, but a budget and coverage plan is mandatory. eHerkenning purchase costs may be included in the budget and are reimbursed if awarded. No application fee.
  • BNG Cultuurfonds: Project Grants (round closing September 2026)
    https://www.bngbank.nl/bng-cultuurfonds/projectsubsidies
    Stichting BNG Cultuurfonds (BNG Bank) · deadline 27 Sep 2026 · EUR 5,000 minimum to EUR 15,000 maximum. The request must represent 5 to 35 percent of total project funding, so at least 65 percent co-financing is required. The fund is never the sole financier, and place-specific projects require at least one local or regional co-financier. No application fee.
  • Stichting Cultuur Eindhoven: Project Subsidy (Projecten, 2027 round 1)
    https://cultuureindhoven.nl/informatie-over-subsidies-2025-2028/
    Stichting Cultuur Eindhoven · deadline 30 Sep 2026 · Maximum EUR 35,000 per application and maximum 80 percent of eligible costs, so at least 20 percent co-financing is required. No application fee.
  • Gemeente Den Haag: Arts and Culture Projects Category B (autumn 2026 round)
    https://www.denhaag.nl/nl/subsidies/subsidies-cultuur-en-evenementen/subsidie-kunst-en-cultuurprojecten-aanvragen/
    Gemeente Den Haag (Municipality of The Hague) · deadline 15 Oct 2026 · EUR 10,000 to 30,000 per application. The municipal culture-budget contribution may not exceed 30 percent of the total project budget, so at least 70 percent co-financing is required. Annual ceiling for the strand is EUR 600,000. No application fee.
  • Stichting NORMA: NORMA Fonds Project Grant (round 4, 2026)
    https://www.stichtingnorma.nl/norma-fonds/aanvragen/
    Stichting NORMA (collecting society for performing artists) · deadline 30 Oct 2026 · Maximum EUR 10,000 per project. Total project budget may not exceed EUR 150,000 and the applicant organisation's annual budget may not exceed EUR 500,000. At least 25 percent of the project budget must come from audience or box-office revenue. Performer fees must meet the 2026 wage norms of EUR 139 per rehearsal and EUR 340 per performance. No application fee.
  • Cultuurloket DigitALL: Implementation Contribution (Implementatiebijdrage, 2026)
    https://cultuurloketdigitall.nl/implementatiebijdrage/
    Cultuurloket DigitALL · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · Up to EUR 30,000. Covers technical modification, system integration, production and deployment costs. Hardware purchase alone is ineligible unless clearly essential to the public experience. No stated co-financing percentage. No application fee.
  • Cultuurloket DigitALL: Pilot Contribution (Pilotbijdrage, 2026-2027, rolling)
    https://cultuurloketdigitall.nl/pilotbijdrage/
    Cultuurloket DigitALL (successor to Kickstart Cultuurfonds) · deadline Rolling / undated · Up to EUR 75,000. Covers pilot development, audience testing, and knowledge development or training via partner organisations if budgeted. Hardware-only purchases are not eligible. No stated co-financing percentage. No application fee. Annual donation budget of EUR 1.9 million in 2026 and 2027.
  • Brabant C: ASML x Brabant C Project Scheme (2026-2027, rolling)
    https://www.brabantc.nl/asml-x-brabant-c-project/
    Brabant C (Provincie Noord-Brabant culture investment fund) in partnership with ASML · deadline Rolling / undated · EUR 25,000 minimum, up to EUR 500,000. Contribution capped at 50 percent of total project budget, so 50 percent co-financing is mandatory. EUR 1.7 million available per year, split evenly between ASML and Brabant C. Requests at or above EUR 50,000 must include a future-viability plan. No application fee.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 6 new grants - week of 13 Jul 2026
item.description:
• Mondriaan Fund: Delfina Foundation Residency 2027 (London)
    https://www.mondriaanfonds.nl/en/apply-for-a-grant/grants/residency/delfina-foundation-londen-uk/
    Mondriaan Fund / Delfina Foundation · deadline Closed 27 Aug 2026 · Subsidy of EUR 9,188 for an artist or EUR 7,232 for a curator/art observer toward travel, material and living costs (a 10 percent personal contribution is automatically deducted by the Mondriaan Fund); studio, living space and Delfina Foundation support are paid directly by the Mondriaan Fund. Contribution for Caribbean-based artists can be increased for higher travel costs. No application fee.
  • Rijkscultuurfondsen: Interdisciplinary Grant
    https://www.mondriaanfonds.nl/en/apply-for-a-grant/grants/interdisciplinary/
    Dutch national cultural funds (Rijkscultuurfondsen), via the Mondriaan Fund · deadline 01 Oct 2026 · EUR 12,500 to 50,000 per project. The individual-maker track is approximately EUR 24,900 for 12 months (income cap EUR 55,000 including the grant).
  • Fonds 21: Kunst & Cultuur Project Grants (rolling, Netherlands)
    https://fonds21.nl/loket/onze-pijlers/kunst-cultuur/
    Fonds 21 · deadline Rolling / undated · Minimum request EUR 10,000, no stated maximum; around EUR 11.5 million awarded per year across all pillars. No application fee.
  • Het Cultuurfonds: Project Grants for Foundations and Associations (rolling, Netherlands)
    https://www.cultuurfonds.nl/aanvragen
    Het Cultuurfonds (formerly Prins Bernhard Cultuurfonds) · deadline Rolling / undated · Typically EUR 15,000 to EUR 50,000 for national project applications by foundations and associations; smaller amounts via provincial chapters and themed funds (EUR 1,500 to EUR 25,000). Individual makers and collectives can request up to EUR 5,000. No application fee.
  • VSBfonds: Kunst & Cultuur Donations (rolling, Netherlands)
    https://www.vsbfonds.nl/donaties/kunst-cultuur
    VSBfonds · deadline Rolling / undated · No fixed minimum or maximum; the requested amount must be in proportion to other funding sources. No application fee.
  • SIDN fonds: Pioneer Projects for a Strong Internet (rolling, Netherlands)
    https://www.sidnfonds.nl/aanvragen
    SIDN fonds · deadline Rolling / undated · Up to EUR 10,000 per pioneer project; theme calls (once or twice a year) fund larger projects above EUR 10,000. No application fee.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 5 new grants - week of 15 Jun 2026
item.description:
• Expo Bart: OPEN HALL 2026 (Free Project Space, Technique & Support)
    https://www.expobart.nl/open-hall/
    Expo Bart · deadline Closed 12 Jul 2026 · No fee and no rent, but also no artist fee or other compensation (geen vergoeding). Provides free use of a 100 m2 fully blackout-able project space, limited technique (2 short-throw beamers, a PA set with mixer and microphones, and light spots) and helping hands, plus promotion of your event via Expo Bart's channels.
  • Stichting Stokroos: Residency at Fundaziun Nairs 2026
    https://stokroos.nl/en/grant-rules/guidelines-residency-fundaziun-nairs/
    Stichting Stokroos · deadline 11 Sep 2026 · Fully supported stay (accommodation and meals paid directly to Fundaziun Nairs) plus an unrestricted living, travel and production budget of EUR 7,000. 80% paid before the residency, the remainder on receipt of a brief final report. No application fee.
  • MIT R&D Collaboration Projects 2026 (MKB Innovatiestimulering Topsectoren)
    https://www.rvo.nl/subsidies-financiering/mit/rd-samenwerkingsprojecten
    Rijksdienst voor Ondernemend Nederland (RVO) · deadline 15 Sep 2026 · Grant covering 35 percent of eligible costs. Small projects EUR 50,000-200,000; large projects EUR 200,000-350,000 per project (EUR 25,000-100,000 or EUR 25,000-175,000 per participant). No application fee.
  • Amarte Fonds: Development and Project Contributions (rolling)
    https://www.amarte.nl/nl/kunst
    Amarte Fonds · deadline Rolling / undated · Development contribution up to EUR 2,750; project contribution up to EUR 5,500. Up to 80 percent paid in advance, remainder after the report is approved. No application fee.
  • WBSO: R&D Tax Credit (rolling, Netherlands)
    https://english.rvo.nl/subsidies-financing/wbso
    Rijksdienst voor Ondernemend Nederland (RVO) · deadline Rolling / undated · Payroll/income tax reduction for R&D, not a cash grant. 2026: 36 percent of the first EUR 380,000 of R&D wage costs (50 percent for startups), 16 percent above; fixed deduction for self-employed. National budget EUR 1.817 billion for 2026. No application fee.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

    https://kasteelwijlre.nl/en/about/news/
    Kasteel Wijlre estate · deadline Closed 28 Jun 2026 · Stipend of EUR 800 per month for three months (EUR 2,400 total) plus production and research compensation up to EUR 2,000. Private accommodation and a small in-house studio provided. All other costs (insurance, food, transport) covered by the resident. No application fee.

    https://sandberg.nl/news/call-for-proposals--temporary-department-20272029-

Approximate daily rate EUR 553.60. The department is also supported by a budget for core tutors and guest contributors, a dedicated department coordinator plus administrative support, and institutional infrastructure and guidance.     Stimuleringsfonds Creatieve Industrie (Creative Industries Fund NL) · deadline Closed 19 Aug 2026 · EUR 10,000-25,000 for solo projects; EUR 10,000-50,000 for collaborative projects with partners. At least 20 percent of total project costs must be covered by co-financing. No application fee.

    Stimuleringsfonds Creatieve Industrie and the Netherlands Film Fund · deadline Closed 25 Aug 2026 · Development: EUR 15,000 for individual makers (plus up to EUR 5,000 coaching, max EUR 20,000) or EUR 25,000 for producers (plus up to EUR 5,000 coaching). Realisation: up to EUR 35,000 for individual makers or up to EUR 125,000 for producers (Fund covers max 85 percent). No application fee.

item.title: 5 new grants - week of 11 May 2026
item.description:
• Stroom Den Haag: PRO Grants 2026 (Research / Projects / Programmes / Investment)
    https://www.stroom.nl/en/stroom-for-artists/financial-support/pro-research
    Stroom Den Haag · deadline Closed 31 May 2026 · Four schemes - PRO Research, PRO Projects, PRO Programmes, and PRO Investment - with amounts typically EUR 2,500 to EUR 20,000+ depending on scheme and proposal.
  • Nederlands Letterenfonds: Project Grants for Literary Translators (August 2026 round)
    https://www.letterenfonds.nl/en-caribbean/funding/project-grants-for-literary-translators
    Nederlands Letterenfonds (Dutch Foundation for Literature) · deadline Closed 15 Aug 2026 · Project-based subsidy. Income cap EUR 52,500 for primary income. Standard minimum rates: EUR 0.0802/word for prose; EUR 2.92/line for poetry. No application fee.
  • NWO: SSH Open Competition XS 2026 - Round 3
    https://www.nwo.nl/en/calls/ssh-open-competition-xs-2026-round-3
    Dutch Research Council (NWO) · deadline 15 Sep 2026 · Up to EUR 50,000 per project
  • Mondriaan Fund: Art Media Grant (October 2026 round)
    https://www.mondriaanfonds.nl/en/apply-for-a-grant/grants/art-media/
    Mondriaan Fund · deadline 15 Oct 2026 · Up to 70% of eligible expenses. Round budget: €229,000. Two structures: fixed grant of €2,480 per month for 1-6 month work periods, OR a flexible grant of up to 12 months with the amount determined by project plan and budget.
  • Nederlands Letterenfonds: Ontwikkelbeurzen voor Literaire Makers (Development Grants)
    https://www.letterenfonds.nl/subsidies/ontwikkelbeurzen-voor-literaire-makers
    Nederlands Letterenfonds (Dutch Foundation for Literature) · deadline Rolling / undated · EUR 500 to EUR 2,500 per grant. No application fee.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 4 new grants - week of 27 Apr 2026
item.description:
• Pictoright Fonds: 2026 Project Funding Rounds
    https://fonds.pictoright.nl/
    Pictoright Fonds · deadline Closed 07 Jun 2026 · Up to €35,000 per project. Applications above €5,000 must show substantial co-financing from other sources.
  • Creative Industry Activities Programme Grant Scheme
    https://www.stimuleringsfonds.nl/en/grants/creative-industry-activities-programme-grant-scheme
    Stimuleringsfonds Creatieve Industrie (Creative Industries Fund NL) · deadline Closed 15 Jun 2026 · Up to €125,000 per year per applicant (overall budget €1,850,000 per year)
  • Stimuleringsfonds: Festivals Creative Industries 2027
    https://www.stimuleringsfonds.nl/en/grants/creative-industries-festivals-grant-scheme-2025-2028
    Stimuleringsfonds Creatieve Industrie · deadline 23 Sep 2026 · Maximum EUR 85,000 per festival; scheme ceiling EUR 1,350,000. Minimum 20 percent co-financing required. No application fee.
  • International Vouchers
    https://www.stimuleringsfonds.nl/en/grants/international-vouchers
    Stimuleringsfonds Creatieve Industrie (Creative Industries Fund NL) · deadline 27 Oct 2026 · Up to €1,500 within Europe (zone 1) / up to €2,500 outside Europe (zone 2)

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).
